question.text: A simple pendulum of length $L$ swings in a vertical plane. The tension of the string when it makes an angle $\theta$ with the vertical and the bob of mass $m$ moves with a speed $v$ is $\mathrm{fg}$ is the gravitational acceleration)

solution.text: The situation is given below For motion along a vertical circular track, the required centripetal force is along the radius and towards the centre of the circle is given by $T-m g \cos \theta=\frac{m v^{2}}{L}$ $\Rightarrow \quad T=\frac{m v^{2}}{L}+m g \cos \theta$
